## History

Elder Clow's wife was present at church when [Ida Ashdown](../character/ida-ashdown.md) fainted as a result of a self-imposed fast by the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club). Alongside Doctor [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), Mrs. Elder Clow helped revive [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) after she collapsed during the service.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P0](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P11](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII.
